issue.title: bip352: GetPubKeyFromInput() should assume inputs are consensus-valid
issue.body:
I saw https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36992, and was surprised that the test vectors were 'fixed', but the test code did not change. So the previous test vectors should have failed?

I saw in the commit message of https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/commit/04393c98c0e5268e02f465dbbfc6ea09bb599c99 that apparently, "BIP352 scanning assumes consensus-valid transactions"

So I wondered if maybe we already did too many checks in bip 352 scanning code?

I did a first quick test by just removing most IsFullyValid() and isCompressed() calls in GetPubkeyFromInput(), and this divides by 10 the time of the bench BIP352_GetPubKey_P2PKH.

So I am wondering if this would be an interesting thing I can work on (finding what exact checks can be safely removed because we assume transactions are already consensus-valid when passed to the function), or if i'm making a wrong assumption and all checks have been kept for a reason?

And also, I was not sure if that can be a separate PR, or if it has to be done in the silent payment branches, because it relies on assumptions about how the method will be called, but the code actually calling it is not in master yet?
